By changing the order of integration in the following double integrals, express the following sum as a single double integral. ∫01∫13f(x,y)dxdy+∫1ln⁡3+1∫ey−13f(x,y)dxdy

a
 ∫1e∫1ln⁡(x+1)f(x,y)dydx
b
 ∫1e∫1ln⁡x+1f(x,y)dydx
c
 ∫13∫eln⁡(x−1)f(x,y)dydx
d
 ∫13∫0ln⁡x+1f(x,y)dydx
e
 ∫13∫0ln⁡x−1f(x,y)dydx
